subject: Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance Overhaul Framework
overview: The committee met with consultants to establish a thematic framework and timeline for a comprehensive update of the city's zoning code through 2025.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Update (Paper 24-033)
items.summary: Consultants from Innes Associates presented a multi-phase project timeline focusing on technical corrections, citywide policies regarding climate and economic development, and geographic studies of squares and corridors. The committee approved motions to request feedback from the Building Commissioner and land use board chairs and tasked councilors with submitting their policy priorities by April 5.
